title: sentilab-open-terms/1
description: The machine-readable record of one submission-terms version (DESIGN rev 3 section 5.6). The terms text is published at a stable URL and its SHA-256 is in the version id: version = sentilab-open-terms/<n>@<text_sha256>. The terms cover evaluation, retention of evidence, and display only if visibility is public; they grant no training, lab-memory or study use; they state the moderation visibility semantics (section 12) and the retention period. A change makes a new version; the manifest lists the accepted versions.

hidden.const: hidden from public pages with the reason; nothing is deleted

retention.description: The retention period of evidence, as an ISO 8601 duration.
